tasks.label: audit-supabase-env-presence
args: const fs=require('fs'); const path='.env.local'; if(!fs.existsSync(path)){console.log('NO_ENV_LOCAL'); process.exit(0);} const txt=fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8'); const lines=txt.split(/\r?\n/); const keys=['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL','NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY','SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY']; const out={}; for(const line of lines){ const m=line.match(/^([^#=]+)=(.*)$/); if(!m) continue; const k=m[1].trim(); let v=m[2].trim(); if((v.startsWith('"')&&v.endsWith('"'))||(v.startsWith("'")&&v.endsWith("'"))) v=v.slice(1,-1); if(keys.includes(k)) out[k]=v?`SET(len:${v.length})`:'EMPTY'; } console.log(JSON.stringify(out,null,2));

tasks.label: audit-supabase-openapi-readonly
args: (async()=>{const fs=require('fs');const txt=fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8');const env={};for(const line of txt.split(/\r?\n/)){if(!line||line.startsWith('#'))continue;const i=line.indexOf('=');if(i<0)continue;env[line.slice(0,i).trim()]=line.slice(i+1).trim();}const url=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;const key=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;if(!url||!key){console.log('MISSING_ENV');return;}const res=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/',{headers:{apikey:key,Authorization:'Bearer '+key}});console.log('status',res.status);const text=await res.text();console.log(text.slice(0,1200));})();

tasks.label: audit-supabase-sample-tables-readonly
args: (async()=>{const fs=require('fs');const txt=fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8');const env={};for(const line of txt.split(/\r?\n/)){if(!line||line.startsWith('#'))continue;const i=line.indexOf('=');if(i<0)continue;env[line.slice(0,i).trim()]=line.slice(i+1).trim();}const url=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;const key=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;const tables=['destinations','destination_contents','destination_highlights','destination_practical_items','destination_faq_items','destination_itineraries','cities','city_images','city_tags','circuits','circuit_contents','circuit_destinations','circuit_images'];for(const t of tables){const endpoint=url+'/rest/v1/'+t+'?select=*&limit=2';const res=await fetch(endpoint,{headers:{apikey:key,Authorization:'Bearer '+key,Prefer:'count=exact'}});const cr=res.headers.get('content-range');let body='';try{body=await res.text();}catch{}let sample='';try{const j=JSON.parse(body);if(Array.isArray(j)&&j.length>0){sample=Object.keys(j[0]).slice(0,12).join(',');}else{sample='NO_ROWS_OR_HIDDEN';}}catch{sample='NON_JSON';}console.log('TABLE',t,'STATUS',res.status,'RANGE',cr||'n/a','COLS',sample);} })();

audit-table-status-batch1
args: $envMap=@{};Get-Content .env.local | ForEach-Object { if($_ -match '^[^#=]+='){ $k,$v=$_.Split('=',2); $envMap[$k]=$v } }; $u=$envMap['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL']; $k=$envMap['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY']; $h=@{apikey=$k; Authorization=('Bearer '+$k); Prefer='count=exact'}; $tables=@('circuits','circuit_contents','circuit_destinations','circuit_images','circuit_concepts','destinations','destination_contents','destination_highlights','destination_highlight_contents','destination_practical_items','destination_faq_items','destination_faq_item_contents','destination_itineraries','destination_itinerary_stops','destination_itinerary_contents','destination_rankings','destination_scores','cities','city_highlights','city_images','city_tags'); foreach($t in $tables){ $uri="$u/rest/v1/$t?select=*&limit=2"; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Headers $h -Method Get; $j=$r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; if($j -is [array] -and $j.Count -gt 0){ $cols=($j[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -join ',') } elseif($j -is [array]) { $cols='NO_ROWS_OR_HIDDEN' } else { $cols='NON_ARRAY' }; Write-Output ("TABLE {0} STATUS {1} RANGE {2} COLS {3}" -f $t,$r.StatusCode,$r.Headers['Content-Range'],$cols) } catch { $resp=$_.Exception.Response; if($resp){ Write-Output ("TABLE {0} STATUS {1} RANGE n/a COLS ERR" -f $t,[int]$resp.StatusCode.value__) } else { Write-Output ("TABLE {0} STATUS n/a RANGE n/a COLS ERR" -f $t) } } }

})();
